title: Non-Inertial Response of Correlations: From Scalar Bell Observables to an Extended Correlation Tensor
summary: A standard Bell observable is a scalar correlation associated with a selected pair of local measurement directions. We formulate it as a projection of a complete two-particle correlation tensor and distinguish two angular sectors. The central result is a reversal of the sign multiplying the cosine law: for coincident calibrated settings, the Bell observable is positive for photons and negative for a fermionic singlet.
